theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hσ : σ'' = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs := by
    rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    refine updatedStatesComm ?_
    rw [List.unzip_zip_left (Nat.le_of_eq (UpdateStatesLength Hup)),
        List.unzip_zip_left (Nat.le_of_eq (InitStatesLength Hinit))]
    intro x hx hx'
    have h : (σ' x).isSome = true := UpdateStatesDefined Hup x hx
    rw [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit x hx'] at h
    cases h
  exact ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl,
    updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit)
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit), Hσ ▸ updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength Hup)
        (updatedStatesDefMonotone (ves := ks'.zip vs') (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))⟩
